page_title: BBC Learning English - English at Work / Decision time
title: Decision time
topic: Language relating to being offered and accepting a promotion
description:
Mr Socrates has sacked Paul from his position as manager of Tip Top Trading and he's offered Anna a promotion to be the new boss. But will she accept the offer?
This episode focuses on the language that you may hear if you are offered a promotion and what to say in return.
phrases: This promotion recognises your achievements at the company.
It's an opportunity of a lifetime.
You would be my right-hand man/woman.

listening_challenge.question: What new job is Paul going to do?
listening_challenge.answer: He's going to be Head Taster at Better Biscuits.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Hello again and welcome back to the final English at Work. Mr Socrates has sacked Paul from his position as manager of Tip Top Trading and he's offered Anna a promotion – to be the new boss. But will she accept?  What's wrong Anna?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: I feel bad about replacing Paul. He's been good to me.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: It's business Anna. He's just not up to the job – but you are.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Thanks. But why me? Can I do the job? I'm not as experienced as Tom.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: I think we have seen over the year that you definitely have more experience than Tom! Go on Anna, you can do it.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Hmmm.

transcript.speaker: Mr Socrates
transcript.text: So Anna… what do you say? Will you replace Paul as the new boss of Tip Top Trading? Come on Anna. This promotion recognises your achievements at the company. It's an opportunity of a lifetime.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: I know.

transcript.speaker: Mr Socrates
transcript.text: You'll be my right-hand man.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: I think he means right-hand woman! It means you'd be his most trusted and invaluable assistant.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: I see.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Anna, if you need time to think you could say "thank you for your kind words" and, "could I have time to consider your offer?"

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Erm, Mr Socrates. This news has come as a bit of a shock. Thank you for your kind words but please could I have some time to consider your offer?

transcript.speaker: Mr Socrates
transcript.text: Oh… OK Anna. But don't leave it too long. I have a habit of changing my mind.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: OK, Mr Socrates… I mean Brad… I'll call you back soon.  Bye.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Oh… has Mr S offered you Paul's job by any chance?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Yes!

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: And you said you'd think about it?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Yes. I'm not sure if I can take on that much responsibility.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: It's easy peasy. I could do it standing on my head.

transcript.speaker: Denise
transcript.text: But he's not offering­ you the job Tom.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Please don't mention this to Paul… not yet… he's very upset.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: I know nothing!

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: You know nothing? About what?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: I mean, I'll remain tight lipped… I won't say a word… until it's all official like. You can count on me.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: "You can count on me"!?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Uh?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: "You can count on me". That was the message with that that bunch of flowers someone sent me. It was you wasn't it?!

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Well… err… I suppose… yes… it was me Anna. I couldn't help it. I… I… love you Anna.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Do you know what Tom… I quite like you too… I think you're… sweet. Now come on and give me a kiss.

transcript.speaker: Paul
transcript.text: Oh crumbs, shall I come back later?!

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: No it's ok Paul. We’re just… getting to know each other a bit better. In fact, Anna… I'd like to ask you something.

transcript.speaker: Denise
transcript.text: Oh, why is Tom getting down on one knee?

transcript.speaker: Paul
transcript.text: I expect he's dropped one of his contact lenses.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: No it's not that. Anna, I'd like to ask you something… err… will you… will you marry me?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: What?!

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Crikey, what a dilemma. Now Anna's got two important questions to answer. Will she take the job as Tip Top Trading's newest and youngest manager? And will she marry Tom?  Here's a reminder of what Mr Socrates had to say about her:
This promotion recognises your achievements at the company.
It's an opportunity of a lifetime.
You would be my right-hand man.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: And if Anna accepts the job, here's what she could say:
I'd be delighted to accept. Thank you.
When would I start?
Could we discuss the terms and conditions of the new job?

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Let's find out what Anna has to say.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Oh Tom, I don't know what to say. It's come as a bit of a shock. Can I have some time to think about it?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: I suppose.

transcript.speaker: Paul
transcript.text: Well, while you think about that, I've got some good news. I've been offered a new job.

transcript.speaker: Denise
transcript.text: That's fantastic news Paul. What is it?

transcript.speaker: Paul
transcript.text: It's to be Head Taster at a company called Better Biscuits.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: That's fantastic news Paul.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Yeah, well done Paul. That's right up your street.

transcript.speaker: Denise
transcript.text: So Anna, does that mean you'll do Paul’s job now?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Don't answer that. Answer my proposal first.

transcript.speaker: Denise
transcript.text: No, I think she should sort out her work first.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: But I've been waiting to ask her for months.

transcript.speaker: Paul
transcript.text: I think it's up to Anna to say what she wants.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Quiet! Look everyone, I can't decide what to say to you Tom, or Mr Socrates. So I've decided I'm going to take a short holiday to have some time to think.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Good idea. Where shall we go?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: On my own Tom. When I return I will give you my answers.

transcript.speaker: Paul
transcript.text: Crumbs. I think I'd better get a biscuit.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: A good idea Anna. But we’re going to have to wait a while to find out what she decides. She needs a rest after learning so much during her year at Tip Top Trading. We hope you've enjoyed learning with her and now feel more confident in using English at work! That’s all from me and the team at Tip Top Trading for now.  Until we meet again, bye!
